na6f65b81d98.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about filling a vacancy in the office of the President?
o: On expiry of the term, the election must be completed before the term expires
A person elected to fill a vacancy holds office only for the predecessor's unexpired term
A vacancy by death, resignation or removal must be filled within six months
The rule on vacancy by expiry of term is in Article 62(1)
na6f65b81d98.x: A President elected to fill a vacancy gets a full five-year term, not the unexpired part.

n3c0faaa496b.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the pardoning powers of the President and Governor?
o: The President may pardon a death sentence
The Governor cannot pardon a death sentence but may suspend, remit or commute it
The Governor may grant pardon in a court-martial case
The President may exercise pardoning power in court-martial cases
n3c0faaa496b.x: The Governor has no power to pardon a court-martial sentence; only the President has.

n4b5d3bdb851.s: Which of the following is NOT correct?
o: Article 60 deals with the President's eligibility for re-election
Article 53 vests the executive power of the Union in the President
Article 56 deals with the President's term and resignation to the Vice-President
Article 58 lays down the qualifications for election as President
n4b5d3bdb851.x: Article 60 concerns the President's oath or affirmation; eligibility for re-election is in Article 57.

n217368aa0f1.s: Under Article 72, the President's power of pardon does NOT necessarily cover which of the following?
o: Sentences imposed under State laws, in every case
Offences against laws within the Union's executive power
All cases involving a death sentence
n217368aa0f1.x: Article 72 covers court-martial sentences, Union-law offences and all death sentences, but not sentences under State laws in every case.

nindian-polity-38-16.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the forms of the pardoning power?
o: Pardon – Removal of both sentence and conviction
Reprieve – Permanent cancellation of the sentence
Commutation – Substitution of a heavier punishment with a lighter one
Remission – Reduction in duration without changing the sentence's character
nindian-polity-38-16.x: A reprieve is only a temporary postponement of execution; removal of sentence and conviction is a pardon.

n343dcb6aa32.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about cases on the pardoning power?
o: Maru Ram (1980) held that the power is exercised on the advice of the Council of Ministers
Kehar Singh (1989) held that the President may examine the evidence afresh
Epuru Sudhakar (2006) allowed limited judicial review on mala fide, arbitrary or irrelevant grounds
Kehar Singh held that a convict has a right to an oral hearing before the President
n343dcb6aa32.x: Kehar Singh held that the President may examine evidence afresh but the convict has no right to an oral hearing.

nca5a33daaea.s: In the Presidential election, the value of an MLA's vote = (population of the State / number of elected MLAs) × ____.
nca5a33daaea.x: An MLA's vote value is State population divided by elected MLAs, multiplied by 1/1000, so it varies with the State's population.

nb90eb9944be.s: Who among the following does NOT take part in the impeachment of the President?
o: Elected members of the Lok Sabha
Nominated members of the Rajya Sabha
Elected members of the State Legislative Assemblies
nb90eb9944be.x: Elected and nominated members of both Houses of Parliament take part; elected MLAs of the States, Delhi and Puducherry do not.

nf0c2f846c2b.s: Disputes connected with the election of the President under Article 71 are decided by:
o: The Supreme Court or the High Courts
nf0c2f846c2b.x: Only the Supreme Court decides them; acts done before an election is declared void remain valid, and a vacancy in the electoral college is no ground for challenge.

n7462f6a1821.s: How many members does the President nominate to the Rajya Sabha?
n7462f6a1821.x: The President nominates twelve members to the Rajya Sabha; under Article 79 the President is part of Parliament.

nindian-polity-8-17.s: Under Article 58, the minimum age for election as President of India is:
nindian-polity-8-17.x: A candidate must be an Indian citizen, have completed 35 years, be qualified for the Lok Sabha and hold no office of profit.

n54c39ed69d3.s: The Comptroller and Auditor General is appointed under Article:
n54c39ed69d3.x: Article 148 concerns the CAG; Article 76 the Attorney General, 155 Governors and 324 the Election Commission.

n53c8be7fce5.s: The electoral college for the election of the President is provided in Article:
n53c8be7fce5.x: Article 54 covers the electoral college; Article 52 creates the office, 60 is the oath and 71 election disputes.

n8908748b6e4.s: While the Vice-President acts as President under Article 65, the Rajya Sabha is presided over by the:
o: Senior-most member of the Rajya Sabha
n8908748b6e4.x: The Vice-President stops functioning as Chairman while acting as President, and the Deputy Chairman presides.

n11d7db690aa.s: Under Article 240, the President may make regulations for Puducherry:
o: Only with the consent of the Lieutenant Governor
When its Legislative Assembly is suspended or dissolved
n11d7db690aa.x: Article 240 covers UTs such as Andaman and Nicobar, Lakshadweep and DNH-DD, and Puducherry when its Assembly is suspended or dissolved.

n7a3b90f037a.s: After returning the advice of the Council of Ministers once for reconsideration, the President must:
o: Refer it to the Supreme Court
n7a3b90f037a.x: The 42nd Amendment made advice binding; the 44th allows one return, after which the President must act according to the advice.

n7fedecdc144.s: The emoluments of the President of India:
o: May be diminished by Parliament during the term
Are decided afresh by each Finance Commission
Cannot be diminished during the term
Can be cut by the Council of Ministers
n7fedecdc144.x: The President's emoluments cannot be diminished during the term; the President also gets a rent-free residence and cannot be a member of any legislature.

n10950664378.s: A joint sitting of Parliament is summoned by the ____ and presided over by the ____.
o: President; Chairman of the Rajya Sabha
President; Speaker of the Lok Sabha
n10950664378.x: Summoning a joint sitting is a legislative function of the President, and the Speaker of the Lok Sabha presides over it.

nf23efcaebce.s: Who was the only President of India elected unopposed?
nf23efcaebce.x: N. Sanjiva Reddy (President 1977–82), from Andhra Pradesh, was elected unopposed; he was earlier Lok Sabha Speaker and AP's first Chief Minister.

nd450a8ad9b2.s: The impeachment resolution against the President must be signed by at least ____ of the members of the House, after 14 days' notice.
nd450a8ad9b2.x: One-fourth of the members must sign after 14 days' notice; the charge may start in either House, and no President has been impeached so far.

nindian-polity-2-40.s: The 15% size limit on the Council of Ministers is contained in Article:
nindian-polity-2-40.x: Article 75(1A) sets the size limit; Article 74 is aid and advice, 75(3) collective responsibility and 76 the Attorney-General.

na2e26578c7c.s: In the formal sense under Article 74, the CJI, judges, the Attorney General and Governors are appointed by the President on the recommendation of the:
na2e26578c7c.x: Under Article 74 the President acts on the aid and advice of the Council of Ministers headed by the PM, so these appointments are formally on the PM's recommendation.

n7d585a7dbbe.s: Financial Emergency is provided under Article:
n7d585a7dbbe.x: Financial Emergency is Article 360; Article 352 is National Emergency, 356 failure of constitutional machinery in a State and 143 advisory jurisdiction.

nindian-polity-8-31.s: Which of the following is exercised by the President on ministerial advice and is NOT a situational discretionary power?
o: Appointing a PM in a hung Parliament
Dismissing a government that has lost its majority
nindian-polity-8-31.x: Appointing Ambassadors is done on ministerial advice; the other three are listed as situational discretion.

nindian-polity-9-8.s: A candidate for Vice-President must be qualified for election as a member of the:
nindian-polity-9-8.x: A Vice-President must be qualified for the Rajya Sabha, besides being an Indian citizen aged 35 holding no office of profit.

n203eeedb826.s: In respect of which of the following must the President give assent, so that the absolute veto cannot apply?
o: A Government Bill when the Cabinet resigned before assent
n203eeedb826.x: A Constitutional Amendment Bill must receive assent; absolute veto may apply to a private member's Bill or a Government Bill after the Cabinet resigns.

ned1775a559c.s: How many terms may a person serve as President of India?
ned1775a559c.x: The President holds office for five years and may be re-elected; the Constitution prescribes no limit on terms.

n07e8959987f.s: The suspensive veto of the President is NOT available in respect of:
n07e8959987f.x: A suspensive veto returns an Ordinary Bill once for reconsideration, with assent mandatory if passed again; it does not apply to Money Bills.

n96610521688.s: Who is the only Chief Justice of India to have acted as President?
n96610521688.x: M. Hidayatullah acted as President in 1969; V.V. Giri won on second-preference votes, and S. Radhakrishnan was the first President from South India.

n36f052783fa.s: The President's prior recommendation is required for the introduction of:
o: An Ordinary Bill in the Rajya Sabha
n36f052783fa.x: Prior recommendation is needed for a Money Bill and a Bill under Article 3, not for every Private Member's Bill.

n858d7e933d4.s: The population base for calculating the value of votes in the Presidential election is the Census of:
n858d7e933d4.x: The 1971 Census is the base, frozen under the 84th Amendment till the first Census after 2026.

n3c19913544e.s: The President of India addresses his resignation to the:
n3c19913544e.x: The President resigns in writing to the Vice-President, who informs the Speaker; the CJI administers the oath under Article 60.

nindian-polity-8-19.s: The impeachment of the President for violation of the Constitution is dealt with in Article:
nindian-polity-8-19.x: Article 61 governs impeachment; either House can prefer the charge and each must pass it by a special majority.

nindian-polity-9-6.s: The electoral college for the election of the Vice-President consists of:
o: All MPs and the State Legislative Assemblies
All members of both Houses of Parliament, elected and nominated
nindian-polity-9-6.x: All MPs, elected and nominated, vote by proportional representation through the single transferable vote and secret ballot; State Assemblies do not take part.

nindian-polity-8-16.s: In the Presidential election, the value of an MP's vote is calculated to ensure:
o: Parity between the Union and the States
Equality between the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha
nindian-polity-8-16.x: MP vote values ensure parity between the Union and the States, while MLA vote values ensure uniformity among States.
